headline: Will foreign currency inflows to Ukraine increase: NBU expands the capabilities of payment companies
summary: The National Bank of Ukraine has expanded the list of operations that non-bank payment service providers can perform through hryvnia payment accounts.
why: The National Bank of Ukraine is the central bank that sets monetary and payment rules, which shape currency flows and the hryvnia's market.
